name: diagnosing-problems
title_zh: 先查清哪里坏了，再动手改的排障流程
tagline_zh: 报错、崩溃、变慢、行为诡异——它不急着给你补丁，而是先逼出「哪一步开始不对」的证据链，再谈修法。
tagline_en: Errors, crashes, slowdowns, weird behavior: it builds an evidence chain of where things first went wrong before.
desc_en: Work out why something is broken before proposing a fix. Use when the user reports an error, a crash, something that stopped working, something slow, or behaviour they cannot explain.
why_zh: 把「猜原因」和「改代码」拆成两步，先复现、再定位、最后才提方案，避免一上来就瞎改。
why_en: Splits guessing from fixing: reproduce, localize, then propose — so you stop patching symptoms blind.
limit_zh: 只做诊断不做修复：它不会替你改代码或跑命令，需要你自己能复现问题、能提供日志或报错原文，否则它只能停在提问阶段。
limit_en: Diagnosis only, no fixes: it won't edit code or run commands, and without a reproduction, logs, or the raw error it stalls at questions.
title_en: Diagnose the break before you patch it
